GEFS - Global Ensemble Forecast System\n30\t\n31\t**Description**: Weather model generating 21-31 separate forecasts (1 control + 20-30 perturbed members). Current version runs 31 members (1 control + 30 perturbed).\n32\t\n33\t**Archive URLs**:\n34\t- **NCEI Historical Archive** (2008-09-23 to 2020-09-23): Dataset [C00691](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/metadata/landing-page/bin/iso?id=gov.noaa.ncdc:C00691)\n35\t  - 1.0° resolution (via HAS system)\n36\t  - 2.5° resolution (via HAS system)\n37\t- **AWS Open Data Registry** (2017-present): [registry.opendata.aws/noaa-gefs](https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-gefs/)\n38\t- **Microsoft Planetary Computer**: [planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/dataset/storage/noaa-gefs](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/dataset/storage/noaa-gefs)\n39\t- **NCEP FTP**: `ftp://ftp.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/gens/prod/`\n40\t- **NCEP HTTP**: `https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/gens/prod/`\n41\t- **NOMADS**: [nomads.ncep.noaa.gov](https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/)\n42\t- **GribStream API**: [gribstream.com/models/gefsatmos](https://gribstream.com/models/gefsatmosmean)\n43\t\n44\t**File Naming Patterns**:\n45\t\n46\tIndividual members (likely PDT 4.1):\n47\t```\n48\tgec00.tCCz.pgrb2a.0p50.fXXX     # Control member (c00)\n49\tgepNN.tCCz.pgrb2a.0p50.fXXX     # Perturbed member (NN = 01-30)\n50\t```\n51\t\n52\tStatistical products (likely PDT 4.8):\n53\t```\n54\tgeavg.tCCz.pgrb2a.0p50.fXXX     # Ensemble mean\n55\tgespr.tCCz.pgrb2a.0p50.fXXX     # Spread\n56\tgemode.tCCz.pgrb2a.0p50_bcfXXX  # Mode (bias-corrected)\n57\tgefs.tCCz.gePPpt.fXXX.alaska_3p0.grib2      # Probability percentiles\n58\tgefs.tCCz.geavg.fXXX.conus_ext_2p5.grib2    # Regional mean\n59\tgefs.tCCz.gespr.fXXX.conus_ext_2p5.grib2    #
